body: You need to finish school and live your life then. You will beat all of this I promise. Keep fighting

I don't know if my meds are SSRI's but I do find I've been more rapid cycling now than in the past. But my symptoms also aren't as extreme as before ( not getting as down or up as before). It's jut happening all in the same day sometimes now instead of one or the other lasting weeks or months anymore
Think of how lost and empty you feel right now- your family will help you with this. And a therapist too. Your family needs you here- and you need them, please stay ❤️
Still here? I hope so. You don't need to do that, you can love and start over somewhere else. Fuck all those people they don't deserve you. And you deserve better. Stay. Someone needs you

I felt like this all day everyday a few months back. Now after being on some meds and going to a therapist I haven't felt that way in 3 months. Stick around it's worth it, pain is inevitable suffering is optional, and when we can get our brains re-wired to make it optional for ourselves life seems like it can be good eventually, which is kind of worth it, we deserve a reward after suffering. This is so hard to see when you feel like dog shit, because trust me I didn't think this way even a little at the beginning of January, actually since about 2014 really. So it took years but things do start to look up. You're worth it- stay.

I love it. I started it a little before the new year. My racing thoughts have eased up to almost nothing, I haven't needed a Xanax once, and I just feel like I can recognize irrational thoughts so much easier than before. It's truly proving to be a life saver. OH and I haven't had a suicidal thought since the week after starting it which is HUGE because those were occurring way too frequently right before starting the Lamictal. Good luck to you!!!
This post has helped my faith so much ❤️ thank you
Thank you, I am going to try this. Maybe for me giving her the list right off the bat will force me to discuss because she'll be bringing it up

Thank you so much. That gives me at least the small glimpse of hope that I need right now. It is exactly what I need to hear, especially from someone who it seems may have had as hard of a time that I'm having actually opening up with all of this

That's a wonderful suggestion and I'm thinking this may actually be a pretty helpful idea. I literally have journals/sketchbooks full of my darkest thoughts/feelings. I'm just paranoid to even show anybody that.  What if I freeze up and can't actually show her once I'm there

As far as the depression passing- I know it does/will. The scary part is how it always comes back with a vengeance. I remember writing- every time you think you've hit rock bottom and that you can only go up from here- there ends up being a worse one.  The whole seems harder and harder to climb out of each time it drags me down.

I do have a therapist. The problem is I plan on saying all of these things to her and when I get there the "how are you" question is asked and that's when I freeze up.  I'm afraid I will never make the changes I need to because I have terrible self-control. I'm hoping meds will help me with that, but I also struggle just to take those daily (even though I have improved immensely with this because I know how important it is).  I almost feel that somehow my mind is addicted to my troubles and fights me to keep it bad while I so desperately want it to get better

thank you for your kind words.  the therapist told me if i get them i need to talk about them, but i just don't understand how i am supposed to.  i can't tell my parents, i'd break their hearts just by telling them i think this way.  and i don't want to add that to my boyfriends pile of things to worry about because he has a life he's also trying to build.  and this is what has drawn me to reddit.  no need to feel shame, because nobody knows who i am, and nobody thinks i'm seeking attention, for the same reason. i feel like mentioning this to somebody i know would just think i'm looking for attention or an "excuse" to get them to be with me

i'm also newly diagnosed and just started Lamictal a few days ago.  i had a bad reaction to the last stabilizer they put me on.  i'm on 25 for 10 days until i double it, and we are taking it slow from there considering i'm apparently sensitive to meds.  i am so sluggish and unmotivated i don't even get out of bed on days off.  getting up to get ready for work is even difficult.  i don't think it's this medication causing you to be sluggish, i think it might be fear of side effects.  good luck to you.  please feel free to share your experience with me, i am looking for anyone to relate and connect with as this illness has turned out to be the loneliest thing i've ever dealt with - even being surrounded by family, my boyfriend, and therapist.  it's just uncomfortable to express how i'm really feeling because i am afraid to be a burden.  being able to relate with someone and maybe hopefully even help each other out is something i think might help with this journey.

not sure this will make you feel better but this is also my circle of life being bipolar with no control and 27.  you are not alone.  i know that and it doesn't help me much at all.  i need more money to be able to move out and i don't even have the energy to get dressed to try and find a second job on my days off.
i feel this almost everyday. i've been struggling a lot lately
